description: Build an unsigned transaction that sets a token approval back to zero, so that spender can no longer move the token. Needs a key. Returns a call for the wallet owner to sign and send on Robinhood Chain (chain ID 4663). No keyfo tool signs. The answer also has sign_url: a keyfo page where the user checks the transaction and signs it in their own wallet. It stays open for 15 minutes and gets a new quote itself when the price is out of date. Show that link to the user, and never ask them to paste the transaction data anywhere.
